items.title: 6.2.8 Rule to Find the Length of the Tangent (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 181-182: 6.2.8 rule (i)-(iv); Example 15; Example 16 Length of a Chord of a Circle with Figure 6.10 (last lines misprinted); Note box

blocks.text: Is sabaq mein do kaam hain. Pehla: 6.2.7 wala tangent ki lambai ka formula ek aasan rule ki shakal mein, jo exam mein foran lagaya ja sake. Doosra: ek milta julta sawal, ke koi line circle mein se kitna lamba tukra (chord) kaatti hai. Dono sawal exam mein baar baar aate hain, aur dono ki jar ek hi hai: Pythagoras. Pehle rule dekhte hain.

items: (i) Circle ki equation is tarah likhiye ke \(x^{2}\) aur \(y^{2}\) ke coefficients 1 hon.
(ii) Equation ki right-hand side zero kijiye.
(iii) Point ke coordinates left-hand side wale expression mein rakhiye.
(iv) Jo jawab aaye us ka square root lijiye.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh rule asal mein Theorem 3 (6.2.7) hi hai, bas qadmon mein likha hua. Qadam (i) bohat zaroori hai: \(5x^{2} + 5y^{2} + \ldots\) ko pehle 5 se taqseem karna parega, kyun ke Theorem 3 \(x^{2} + y^{2} + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\) ke liye saabit hua tha.
Qadam (ii) bhi zaroori hai: agar circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 4x = 5\) likha ho to pehle 5 ko left par laaiye: \(x^{2} + y^{2} - 4x - 5 = 0\). Warna point rakhne par ghalat number aayega.
Agar qadam (iv) mein root ke andar negative number aaye to samajh lijiye point circle ke andar hai aur tangent mumkin hi nahin.

Rule ko ek recipe ki tarah samjhiye: pehle bartan saaf (coefficients 1, right side zero), phir masala daalo (point ke coordinates), aur aakhir mein pakao (square root). Agar pehla qadam chhor diya to baqi sab theek karne ke bawajood jawab ghalat aayega. Is liye har sawal mein sab se pehle equation ki shakal dekhiye.

Ab kitab ki pehli misaal. Is mein jaan boojh kar coefficient 5 rakha gaya hai, taa ke dekha ja sake ke aap rule ka pehla qadam yaad rakhte hain ya nahin. Saath hi \(\frac{14}{5}y\) jaisa fraction bhi aayega; ghabraiye nahin, point rakhne par yeh khud ek saaf number ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Example 15
blocks.problem: Find the length of the tangent from point \(P(2, -5)\) to the circle \(5x^{2} + 5y^{2} + 10x + 14y - 15 = 0\).
steps:
Diya gaya: point \(P(2, -5)\) aur circle \(5x^{2} + 5y^{2} + 10x + 14y - 15 = 0\).
Maloom karna: \(P\) se circle par tangent ki lambai.
Tareeqa: 6.2.8 ka rule. Sab se pehle \(x^{2}\), \(y^{2}\) ke coefficients 1 karne hain (yahan 5 hain), phir point rakh kar square root lena hai.

Qadam 1: Standard form (coefficients 1)
\[x^{2} + y^{2} + 2x + \dfrac{14}{5}y - 3 = 0\]
Kyun: Theorem 3 ka formula sirf us equation par lagta hai jis mein \(x^{2}\), \(y^{2}\) ke coefficients 1 hon (rule ka step (i)). Right side pehle hi zero hai (step (ii)).

Qadam 2: Point rakhna aur square root lena
Tangent ki lambai:
\[\sqrt{(2)^{2} + (-5)^{2} + 2(2) + \dfrac{14}{5}(-5) - 3}\]
\[= \sqrt{4 + 25 + 4 - 14 - 3}\]
\[= \sqrt{16} = 4\]
Kyun: rule ke steps (iii) aur (iv). \(\frac{14}{5}(-5) = -14\); dhyan dein ke yahan minus aata hai.

Tasdeeq:
Centre \(\left(-1, -\frac{7}{5}\right)\), \(r^{2} = 1 + \frac{49}{25} + 3 = \frac{149}{25}\). \(|CP|^{2} = 3^{2} + \left(-5 + \frac{7}{5}\right)^{2} = 9 + \frac{324}{25} = \frac{549}{25}\). Is liye \(|PT|^{2} = \frac{549 - 149}{25} = 16\), \(|PT| = 4\). Agar 5 se taqseem na karte to \(\sqrt{80} = 4\sqrt{5}\) aata, jo ghalat hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Example 16 ek alag qisam ka sawal hai: tangent nahin, balke woh chord (circle ke andar line ka tukra) jo koi line circle se kaatti hai. Kitab ne ise yahan isliye rakha hai ke yeh bhi ek lambai hai jo isi tarah ke hisaab se nikalti hai. Figure 6.10 mein line circle ko \(P\) aur \(Q\) par kaat rahi hai; \(PQ\) ki lambai chahiye.

blocks.alt: A circle with its centre marked by a dot. The line y = mx + c, drawn with arrows at both ends, cuts the circle at two points: P(x1, y1) on the upper right and Q(x2, y2) on the lower left. PQ is the chord.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.10: The line y = mx + c cuts the circle x² + y² = a² at P(x1, y1) and Q(x2, y2) (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: Is misaal mein ek purani magar bohat kaam ki chaal istemal hogi. Line ko circle mein rakhne se \(x\) ki quadratic banti hai, jis ke roots \(x_{1}\) aur \(x_{2}\) hain. Roots ko quadratic formula se nikalna lamba aur ulajhne wala kaam hai, khaas taur par jab sab kuch letters (\(a\), \(m\), \(c\)) mein ho. Lekin distance formula ko asal mein \((x_{1} - x_{2})^{2}\) chahiye, aur yeh roots ke sum aur product se seedha nikal aata hai. Is liye hum roots nikale baghair kaam chala lenge.

blocks.title: Example 16
blocks.problem: Length of a Chord of a Circle: Find the length of intercept cut off from the line \(y = mx + c\) by the circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = a^{2}\).
steps:
Diya gaya: circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = a^{2}\) aur line \(y = mx + c\) jo circle ko do points par kaatti hai.
Maloom karna: chord (intercept) \(PQ\) ki lambai.
Tareeqa: line ko circle mein rakh kar \(x\) ki quadratic banayenge. Roots nikalne ki zaroorat nahin; roots ka jor aur zarb (sum aur product) kaafi hain, kyun ke distance formula mein \((x_{1} - x_{2})^{2} = (x_{1} + x_{2})^{2} - 4x_{1}x_{2}\) aata hai.

Qadam 1: Line ko circle mein rakhna
Intersection points \(P(x_{1}, y_{1})\) aur \(Q(x_{2}, y_{2})\) maan lijiye:
\[x^{2} + (mx + c)^{2} = a^{2}\]
\[x^{2} + m^{2}x^{2} + 2mcx + c^{2} = a^{2}\]
\[(1 + m^{2})x^{2} + 2mcx + (c^{2} - a^{2}) = 0\]
Kyun: \(P\) aur \(Q\) dono line aur circle par hain, is liye \(x_{1}\), \(x_{2}\) is quadratic ke roots hain.

Qadam 2: Roots ka sum aur product
\[x_{1} + x_{2} = -\dfrac{2mc}{1 + m^{2}}\]
\[x_{1}x_{2} = \dfrac{c^{2} - a^{2}}{1 + m^{2}}\]
Kyun: \(Ax^{2} + Bx + C = 0\) ke roots ka sum \(-\frac{B}{A}\) aur product \(\frac{C}{A}\) hota hai.

Qadam 3: \(y_{1} - y_{2}\) ko \(x\) mein likhna
Kyun ke \(P\) aur \(Q\) line par hain:
\[y_{1} = mx_{1} + c, \quad y_{2} = mx_{2} + c\]
\[y_{1} - y_{2} = m(x_{1} - x_{2})\]
Kyun: minus karne se \(c\) cancel ho jata hai.

Qadam 5: Sum aur product rakhna
Kitab yahan likhti hai "Substituting \(x_{1} - x_{2}\) and \(x_{1}x_{2}\)"; asal mein \(x_{1} + x_{2}\) aur \(x_{1}x_{2}\) rakhe ja rahe hain (neeche Kitab ki ghalti dekhiye).
Pehle sirf root ke andar wala hissa saada karte hain:
\[(x_{1} + x_{2})^{2} - 4x_{1}x_{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{4m^{2}c^{2}}{(1 + m^{2})^{2}} - \dfrac{4(c^{2} - a^{2})}{1 + m^{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{4m^{2}c^{2} - 4(1 + m^{2})(c^{2} - a^{2})}{(1 + m^{2})^{2}}\]
Kyun: sum ka square aur product rakha, phir common denominator \((1 + m^{2})^{2}\) liya.

Tasdeeq:
\(a = 5\), \(m = 0\), \(c = 3\) lijiye: line \(y = 3\) circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 25\) ko \((\pm 4, 3)\) par kaatti hai, chord ki lambai 8. Formula: \(\frac{2}{1}\sqrt{25 - 9} = 8\). Theek. Aur \(c^{2} = a^{2}(1 + m^{2})\) (tangent) par lambai zero aati hai, jaisa hona chahiye.
blocks.answer: Chord ki lambai: \[PQ = \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{1 + m^{2}}}\sqrt{a^{2}(1 + m^{2}) - c^{2}}\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Example 16 ke hisaab mein jahan bachay aksar phisalte hain:
1. \(\left(\frac{2mc}{1 + m^{2}}\right)^{2} = \frac{4m^{2}c^{2}}{(1 + m^{2})^{2}}\); neeche wala bracket bhi square hota hai.
2. Common denominator lete waqt doosre fraction ko upar neeche \((1 + m^{2})\) se zarb karna parta hai; isi liye \(4(1 + m^{2})(c^{2} - a^{2})\) aaya.
3. Bracket ke aage minus ho to andar ke har term ka sign badalta hai: \(-(c^{2} - a^{2} + m^{2}c^{2} - m^{2}a^{2}) = -c^{2} + a^{2} - m^{2}c^{2} + m^{2}a^{2}\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Example 16 (Length of a Chord of a Circle) mein do ghaltiyan hain:
1. Kitab "Substituting \(x_{1} - x_{2}\) and \(x_{1}x_{2}\)" likhti hai; asal mein \(x_{1} + x_{2}\) aur \(x_{1}x_{2}\) rakhe jate hain.
2. Aakhri do lines mein powers ghayab hain ("m2c2", "a2", "1 + m2") aur aakhri line mein minus ka nishan bhi gum hai. Sahi jawab:
\[PQ = \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{1 + m^{2}}}\sqrt{a^{2}(1 + m^{2}) - c^{2}}\]

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Numerical sawalon mein aksar zyada aasan yeh hota hai ke intersection points seedhe nikaal lein aur phir un ke darmiyan faasla (distance) nikaal lein.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Agar line centre se guzre, yani \(c = 0\), to chord ki lambai kya hogi? (Formula: \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{1 + m^{2}}}\sqrt{a^{2}(1 + m^{2})} = 2a\). Bilkul theek: centre se guzarne wali chord diameter hoti hai, aur diameter radius ka dugna hai.)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Chord ka formula dekhne ka ek chhota raasta (yeh hamari taraf se izafa hai): centre se line ka faasla \(d = \frac{|c|}{\sqrt{1 + m^{2}}}\) hai, aur centre se chord par giraya gaya perpendicular chord ko do barabar hisson mein baant deta hai. To Pythagoras se:
\[PQ = 2\sqrt{a^{2} - d^{2}}\]
\[= 2\sqrt{a^{2} - \dfrac{c^{2}}{1 + m^{2}}}\]
Yeh bilkul kitab wala jawab hi hai, bas dusri shakal mein. Jaise roti ko seedha kaatein to kata hua kinara (chord) jitna centre ke qareeb, utna lamba.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh misaal kitab ki nahin. Line \(y = x + 1\) circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 25\) se kitni lambi chord kaatti hai? Yahan \(m = 1\), \(c = 1\), \(a = 5\):
\[PQ = \dfrac{2}{\sqrt{2}}\sqrt{25(2) - 1} = \sqrt{2}\cdot 7 = 7\sqrt{2}\]
Note wala seedha tareeqa: \(x^{2} + (x + 1)^{2} = 25\) se \(x^{2} + x - 12 = 0\), yani \(x = 3\) ya \(x = -4\); points \((3, 4)\) aur \((-4, -3)\). Faasla \(\sqrt{49 + 49} = 7\sqrt{2}\). Dono tareeqon se ek hi jawab.

Aakhri baat: is sabaq ke dono formulas ko ratne ke bajaye un ki jaron ko yaad rakhiye. Tangent ki lambai Pythagoras hai (centre, point aur point of contact ka right triangle). Chord ki lambai bhi Pythagoras hai (centre, chord ka beech wala point aur chord ka sira). Jaron ko samajh liya to formula kabhi nahin bhoolega.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Tangent ki lambai: \(x^{2}\), \(y^{2}\) ke coefficients 1 aur right side 0 kijiye, point rakhiye, square root lijiye.
2. \(y = mx + c\) ki \(x^{2} + y^{2} = a^{2}\) se kati chord: \(PQ = \frac{2}{\sqrt{1 + m^{2}}}\sqrt{a^{2}(1 + m^{2}) - c^{2}}\).
3. Chord ka formula sirf roots ke sum aur product se banta hai; numerical sawalon mein points seedhe nikaal lena aksar aasan hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(x^{2}\) ke coefficient se taqseem na karna (Example 15 mein 4 ki jagah \(\sqrt{80}\) aa jata).
2. Example 16 ki kitab wali aakhri line naqal kar lena, jis mein minus ka nishan gum hai.
3. \((x_{1} - x_{2})^{2} = (x_{1} + x_{2})^{2} + 4x_{1}x_{2}\) likhna; sahi sign minus hai.
